notes.zh-CN: 回合进行中也能插话：输入框不再被挡住，发送会停下当前回合并立即把这条消息交给 Agent，转录、已写入的文件与模型设置都保留。
notes.en: You can now interject while a turn is running: the composer stays available, and sending stops the current turn and hands your message to the agent right away, keeping the transcript, files already written and the model settings.
